description: This Java class 'FeaturedItemsController' is a Spring MVC controller that manages the CRUD operations and page display functionalities for featured product items within an admin catalog module. It handles listing, adding, and removing featured items, including interactions with services for products, categories, and relationships.

classes.name: FeaturedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing featured product items in admin interface, supporting listing, addition, and removal of featured products.

methods.name: displayFeaturedItems
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the featured items page, setting up the model with categories.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated listing of featured products, returning JSON containing product details.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a product to the featured items list.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a product from the featured items list.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the menu state in the model for UI navigation.
